title: Blue Cheese and Mustard Toasties
blurb: Crisp toasted bread filled with tangy blue cheese and a hint of Dijon mustard.
steps: Crumble the blue cheese into a bowl and add the Dijon mustard, mixing them together loosely.
Spread the mixture over two slices of bread, then season with a small pinch of salt.
Place the remaining slices on top to make two sandwiches.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Place both sandwiches in the pan and cook for about 4 minutes until the underside is golden and crisp.
Flip the sandwiches carefully and cook for another 4 minutes until the second side is golden and the cheese has softened.
Remove from the pan and cut each sandwich in half to serve.
